# Changelog

## 0.3.0 — first public release (version aligned with nibart 0.3.0)
- **Four more styles (83)**: `dedication`, `plank`, `torn` and `coil` (paper and craft frames, formerly the page frames of faboxyst) and the `binding` option of `coil`.
- Same code as the last development version (79 styles; see the history below, whose numbers 0.1.0–0.11.0 were internal): the package is published as **0.3.0**, like nibart.
- **Reference manual** (EN + FR, ~28 pages, `docs/manual-en.pdf`, `docs/manual-fr.pdf`): anatomy of a frame, the eight functions with parameter tables and live examples, all 16 options with live comparisons, a catalogue of the 79 styles (pre-rendered previews, `docs/catalogue/`, `scripts/build-catalogue.sh`), recipes, notes, index of functions, options and styles. Sources: `docs/manual.typ`, `docs/_h.typ`, `docs/_styles.typ` (generated by `scripts/gen-styles-info.py`).
- **Two editions** built by `scripts/package.py`: *Universe* (lean, `@preview`, the manual PDFs kept in the tree and listed in `exclude`) and *local* (full, `@local/nibframe` + `@local/nibart`, `install.sh` / `install.ps1`). README conditional blocks `<!--universe-->` / `<!--local-->`.
- Author and repository set (FERGOUS Abdelhak, @fergousA; `github.com/fergousA/nibframe`) in `typst.toml`, `LICENSE`, READMEs, manual.

# Development history (internal numbering, before the first public release)

## dev 0.11.0
- Three more styles (79): `stepped` (interlocking stepped pyramids), `deckle` (waves fading from a deckled edge) and `label` (slim double rule with curls and fleurons). `gallery4` now shows twelve models.

## dev 0.10.0
- Three more classic diploma borders (76 styles): `diamond-chain` (chain of nested diamonds), `lace-grid` (lace grid of quatrefoils) and `diploma-shell` (undulating border with a guilloché shell fan in the middle of the top and bottom sides; the fan is an optional ornament, removed by `corners: false`).
- `examples/gallery4.typ` now shows nine models.

## dev 0.9.0
- Four more models inspired by printed certificates and banknote borders (73 styles): `medallion` (diamond lattice with large guilloché discs over the corners), `rosette-ribbon` (ribbon of hairlines pinched at intervals, a rosette on each pinch), `fleur-edge` (scalloped edge, fleurons and lattice) and `filigree` (mirrored scrolls). All keep the continuous contour and optional corners.
- A fourth gallery file, `examples/gallery4.typ`, shows them with the `certificate` styles and the background textures.

## dev 0.8.0
- Two certificate styles, inspired by printed diplomas: `certificate` and `certificate-ribbon` — a two-colour guilloché band, a beaded outer edge and acanthus flourishes in the corners (drawn over the contour; `corners: false` removes them). Combine with `texture: "rosettes"` for the faint guilloché background.

## dev 0.7.0
- Seventeen more styles (67 in total), in four families:
  - **Celtic knotwork** (`knot-cartouche`, `knot-eights`, `knot-lozenge`, `knot-ring`, `knot-rope`, `knot-triple`, `knot-weave`, `knot-blocks`): real interlace computed from a *wall grid* — strands run along the diagonals of a grid, bounce off the walls and cross at open edges; over/under alternates automatically. Each tile is a closed knot, mirror-symmetric in shape and colour, so every side and the whole frame are symmetric.
  - **Floral** (`daisy`, `sakura`, `lotus`, `palmette`).
  - **Arabesque** (`ogee`, `rinceau`, plus `palmette`).
  - **Islamic** (`girih`, `hexastar`, `strap`).
- A third gallery file, `examples/gallery3.typ`.

## dev 0.6.0
- Ten more styles (50 in total): `airmail`, `checker`, `stars`, `hearts`, `eggdart`, `vitruvian`, `arches`, `tapa`, `stripes`, `herringbone`. All keep the continuous contour, symmetric sides and optional corners.
- A second gallery file, `examples/gallery2.typ`, shows the ten new styles.

## dev 0.5.0
- Four more security-print borders (40 styles): `bill-wavy`, `bill-diploma`, `bill-lattice`, `bill-weave` — undulating outlines, diploma-style fans, triangle-wave lattice.
- New options for every style: `texture` (`"scales"`, `"waves"`, `"rosettes"`: a pale guilloché background inside the frame), `texture-color`, and `seal` (a guilloché rosette in the bottom-right corner).

## dev 0.4.0
- Ten security-print guilloché borders (36 styles in total): `bill-lens`, `bill-fan`, `bill-ribbon`, `bill-shell`, `bill-wave`, `bill-frill`, `bill-net`, `bill-swell`, `bill-plait`, `bill-rosette`. Each is a bundle of 10–30 hairlines, every line a phase-shifted wave; `color` is the main family, `accent` the second one (corner rosettes, extra rules).
- The gallery has a third page for them.
- **Continuous contour, symmetric patterns.** Every style now has a continuous closed contour (outer and inner rule); the `bill-*` hairlines run all the way round the page as closed loops. Patterns placed along the sides use an even number of cells and the second half is the mirror image of the first, so each side, and the whole frame, is symmetric left/right and top/bottom.
- **Optional corner ornaments.** New option `corners` (default `true`): `corners: false` keeps only the continuous contour and the side pattern. `corner-color` sets the colour of the `bill-*` corner rosettes (default: a lighter accent, drawn over the contour).
- **Thinner frames.** Default `band` is about 25 % slimmer (5–7.5 mm instead of 6–10 mm) and `inset` is 4 mm.

## dev 0.3.0
- Thirteen new styles (26 in total): `baroque`, `triquetra`, `solomon`, `zellige`, `seigaiha`, `kilim`, `laurel`, `flowers`, `stamp`, `film`, `photo`, `neon`, `illumination`.
- New option `paper` (default `white`): colour of the page, used by styles that hide overlaps.
- The gallery now has two pages (old / new styles).

## dev 0.2.0
- Eight new styles: `arabesque` (calligraphic vine with tendrils and leaves), `islamic` (interlaced eight-pointed stars), `greek` (key meander), `scallop` (lace arcs and corner fans), `deco` (Art Deco ticks and fans), `chain` (interlocked links), `braid` (Celtic double braid), `banknote` (guilloché rosettes).
- Slimmer frames: `band: auto` now picks 6–9 mm depending on the style (was 12 mm for all) and `inset` defaults to 5 mm (was 7 mm). Pass `band:`/`inset:` to get the old look.
- `banknote` uses fewer, lighter curves (it could exhaust memory on A4).
- The code is split into `styles.typ` (geometry and styles) and `lib.typ` (API).

## dev 0.1.0
- First release: styles `classic`, `celtic`, `guilloche`, `braces`, `pearls`; `framed`, `frame-background`, `frame-margin`, `frame-box`, `frame-graphic`, `frame-items`.
